high_level_description: This image is an aerial view of a striking coastal landscape. The scene is dominated by the contrast between the deep blue and turquoise waters of the ocean on the left side and the black sand beach that stretches along the center of the image. The waves are crashing onto the shore, creating white foam where they meet the sand. To the right of the black sand beach, there is a vibrant green area that appears to be a grassy or marshy region.
